_doc: Boss templates. Bosses are generated endlessly by gen/bosses.js: boss n has an equivalent wave of firstWave + stepWaves*n, hp = hpMult * enemy hp at that wave, a seeded name, 2 mechanics (+1 more every 5 bosses) drawn from 'mechanics', and drops a weapon (luck tier +2), money, a free upgrade level and a unique mutation 'boss:<n>'. Add a mechanic by adding it here and handling its id in sim/bosses.js.

mechanics.name: Phase shield
mechanics.text: Immune to damage for 5 s every 20 s

mechanics.name: Shockwave
mechanics.text: Every 10 s hits the base for 8% of its HP
